next_step: AE to send revised Dedicated proposal (3 commit tiers + burst + sample invoice) by 2026-03-12
notes:
Summary:
- Mid-market product analytics SaaS. Primary buyer: VP Eng + Head of ML. Finance + Procurement engaged in last two weeks.
- Began on Hosted API POC (45 days) to validate latency & quality for in-app personalization and help center assistant. Results: accuracy and coherence OK; spikes in cost noticed under bursty traffic.
Commercial / Dedicated ask (main negotiation points):
- Customer requests a Dedicated commitment to get predictable unit costs. Initial ask: 10 committed units (vGPU-equivalent) with burst pool to 16 for peak traffic.
- Ramp schedule requested: Month 1 = 25% effective billed commit (discounted), Month 2 = 60%, Month 3+ = 100%. Wants ramp credits applied to month 1 and month 2 invoices.
- Overage policy: customer prefers softened overage (1.25x) with prioritized burst routing. Redwood's standard draft shows 1.5x overage. This is the primary pricing contention.
- Billing cadence: prefer monthly billed commit vs Redwood default quarterly. Finance wants sample monthly invoice showing commit, burst, overage lines.
- SLA/latency: target p95 < 250ms for typical 512-token personalization calls; p99SLO discussions ongoing.
- Security: SSO via SAML mandatory, KMS key rotation policy required, 12-month audit log retention, data residency in NA.
Operational asks / integrations:
- SE action: validate VPC peering, egress IP allowlist, KMS integration flow and tenant key options.
- Fallback plan: client requires automatic fallback to Hosted API only in limited modes (read-only responses) when Dedicated pool saturated; prefer prioritized routing to dedicated first.
Customer comments:
- "We need clean monthly numbers for finance forecasting; can't absorb surprise bills." 14 VP Finance
- "If we commit, we expect a predictable per-token cost. Burst should be available without kill-switching product features." 14 Head of ML
Proposed commercial options discussed in call:
- Option A: 10 commit / burst 16 / overage 1.5x / monthly billing (Redwood standard ramp credit applies).
- Option B (customer counter): 10 commit / burst 16 / overage 1.25x for months 1-3, then 1.5x thereafter; explicit 72-hour emergency free burst credit for first 60 days.
- Option C: 6 commit (lower ARR) with higher per-commit discount, auto-scale burst subject to higher overage.
Open items for next meeting:
- Legal: finalize SOW redlines (waiting on procurement legal).
- AE to provide sample monthly invoice and TCO model comparing Hosted vs Dedicated at proposed usage profile.
- SE to confirm peering timeline and provide runbook for fallback to Hosted API.
Quick win criteria (internal):
- Signed SOW with agreed overage multiplier & ramp schedule.
- PO issued by procurement within 6 weeks of SOW sign.
Risks:
- Negotiation stall on overage multiplier and billing cadence.
- SOC2 evidence timing could delay procurement.
